# routeros_mpls_settings (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `allow_fast_path` (Boolean) Whether to allow MPLS FastPath processing.
- `dynamic_label_range` (String) Range of the label numbers used for the dynamic label allocation, written as `Start-End` or as a single value. Valid label numbers are 16..1048575.
- `propagate_ttl` (Boolean) Whether to copy the TTL value from the IP header to the MPLS header.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
